title: Qualify control_request_expired retry-key guidance for keyless requests
outcome: The control_request_expired wire message and behavioral-control contract explain exact retry without requiring an idempotency key on operations that have none.
acceptance: The ControlRequestExpired error message and behavioral-control-plane expiry guidance require reusing the original idempotency key only when the request carries one, matching cli-and-mcp.md.
Existing expiry semantics, exact retained request/payload and same-connection guidance, and uncertainty about prior operations remain unchanged; relevant message tests and documentation checks pass.
